newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Sepi sets Gas Natural price at 26,000 pta.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Sepi sets Gas Natural price at 26,000 pta.

text.p: Spain's state industrial holding group Sepi said on Monday that it set the share placement price for the sale of 3.81 percent of Gas Natural at 26,000 pesetas per share.
Demand during the subscription period exceeded the total 1.4 million shares offered by 352 percent.
According to the terms of the sale, 60 percent of the shares will be reserved for Spanish and Andorran institutional buyers with the rest going to foreign institutions.
Investors in Madrid, Barcelona, Edinburgh, London and Paris were treated to a "road show" by Gas Natural and Sepi management on the Spanish energy firm.

They said Gas Natural will increase its productivity by the year 2000 to 1,000 clients per employee from the current 700 clients per employee. The energy firm also plans to double sales in Spain and make 500 billion pesetas in investments.

"This information must have been measured positively by investors, given that it has allowed the raising of the price per share from 23,000 at the start of the subscription period to the 26,000 pesetas final offer," Sepi said in a statement.
